nodes.name: Thermal annealing in N2 (250°C)
nodes.procedure: Annealing pristine PrBaCo2O6-δ in a pure N2 atmosphere for 30 min at 250°C to generate oxygen vacancy concentration δ=0.25.
nodes.source_text: two different oxygen vacancy concentrations (δ) of 0.25 and 0.5 were generated in PrBaCo2O6-δ metal oxide by annealing pristine PrBaCo2O6-δ in a pure N2 atmosphere for 30min at 250 and 600°C, respectively

nodes.name: Thermal annealing in N2 at 600°C
nodes.procedure: Annealing pristine PrBaCo2O6-δ in a pure N2 atmosphere for 30 min at 600°C.
nodes.source_text: annealing pristine PrBaCo2O6-δ in a pure N2 atmosphere for 30min at ... 600°C

nodes.name: H2/Ar reduction
nodes.procedure: Reducing CaMnO3 under 5% H2/Ar at 350°C for 3 h to produce highly-ordered oxygen vacancies.
nodes.source_text: highly-ordered oxygen vacancies can be produced along the directions normal to the ab plane in Ca2Mn2O5 by reducing CaMnO3 under 5% H2/Ar at 350°C for 3h

nodes.name: Two-step NiCo2O4 synthesis
nodes.procedure: 1. NiCo hydroxide ultrathin nanosheet obtained by adding NH3 solution containing p-aminobenzoic into mixture solution of Co(NO3)2 and Ni(NO3)2 under vigorous stirring. 2. Calcining the hydroxide in air at 300°C.

nodes.source_text: calcining NiCo hydroxide ultrathin nanosheet (obtained by adding NH3 solution containing p-aminobenzoic into the mixture solution of Co(NO3)2 and Ni(NO3)2 under vigorous stirring) in air at 300°C

nodes.name: NaBH4 reduction
nodes.procedure: Mesoporous Co3O4 nanowires fabricated by chemical method then soaked in 1M NaBH4 aqueous solution for 1h at room temperature. Finally, thoroughly washed with DI water.
nodes.source_text: mesoporous Co3O4 nanowires were initially fabricated by a chemical method and then soaked in 1MNaBH4 aqueous solution for 1h at room temperature. Finally, the reduced Co3O4 nanowires were thoroughly washed with DI water

nodes.name: Vacuum annealing BaTiO3
nodes.procedure: Heat treatment of pristine BaTiO3 under vacuum condition at 1300°C for 2h.
nodes.source_text: rich oxygen vacancies in BaTiO3 perovskite oxide after a heat treatment at 1300°C under vacuum condition for 2h

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows disordered structure with possible oxygen vacancy positions in Fe1Co1Ox compared to perfect structure without oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Zhuang et al. found Fe1Co1Ox with oxygen vacancies shows a disordered structure from HRTEM compared to the perfect structure without oxygen vacancies...

nodes.characterization_summary: ABF-STEM imaging directly visualizes layered ordering of oxygen vacancies in La0.2Sr0.8CoO3-δ (LSCO28) and SrCoO3-δ (SCO), distinguishing complete (CoO2) and anion-deficient (CoO2-δ) layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the layered ordering of oxygen vacancies in La0.2Sr0.8CoO3-δ (LSCO28) and SrCoO3-δ (SCO) samples were directly visualized using annular bright-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (ABF-STEM) imaging... anion-complete (CoO2) and anion-deficient (CoO2-δ) layers are clearly distinguished

nodes.characterization_summary: STM micrographs directly image oxygen vacancies on TiO2 anatase (101) surface as white dots.
nodes.evidence_snippet: oxygen vacancies on TiO2 surface were directly visualized from STM micrographs (Fig. 5e and f) in which the white dots represent the oxygen vacancies

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD peaks of Sr2Fe1.3Ni0.2Mo0.5O6-δ shift to lower angles after Ar and 5% H2/Ar treatment at 700°C, indicating increased cell volume and oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Zhu et al. found the XRD peaks of Sr2Fe1.3Ni0.2Mo0.5O6-δ shift to lower angles without phase transformation after treating... indicating the formation of oxygen vacancies

nodes.characterization_summary: HRXRD peaks shift to lower 2θ values for La0.7Sr0.3CoO3-δ films after vacuum annealing, showing increased out-of-plane lattice parameter c and unit cell volume.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Liu et al. adopted high-resolution (HR) XRD to probe changes of out-of-plane lattice parameter for La0.7Sr0.3CoO3-δ/LaAlO3 and La0.7Sr0.3CoO3-δ/SrTiO3 films after vacuum annealing...

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS O 1s peak at 531.2 eV in NiCo2O4 assigned to oxygen vacancies; shows reduction of cation valence states in Sr2Fe1.3Ni0.2Mo0.5O6-δ after thermal treatment.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the O peak at 531.2 eV is assigned to the oxygen vacancies... Zhu et al. confirmed the existence of Ni2+, Fe2+/Fe3+ and Mo5+/Mo6+ in the Sr2Fe1.3Ni0.2Mo0.5O6-δ perovskite after thermal treatment

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge XANES of reduced Co3O4 shows shift to lower energy compared to pristine Co3O4, indicating lower average oxidation state of cobalt.
nodes.evidence_snippet: by comparing the pre-edge energy of the Co K-edge XANES of pristine Co3O4 and reduced Co3O4... a shift to lower energy... indicating a lower average oxidation state

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS shows decreased intensity of first coordination shell (Co-O bonds) in Vo-Co3O4, indicating lower coordination number and more oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the decrease in intensity of the first coordination shell reveals the lower coordination numbers in the first shell in Vo-Co3O4 compared to Co3O4, suggesting more oxygen vacancies

nodes.characterization_summary: sXAS O-K edge shows new peak at ~533.4 eV assigned to oxygen vacancies in laser-ablated Co3O4 (LCO/LN-CO).
nodes.evidence_snippet: a new peak at ∼533.4 eV, which is assigned to oxygen vacancy, appears in the O-K edge spectra of LCO/LN-CO with more oxygen vacancies

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS O-K edge fine structure damps out with increasing oxygen vacancy concentration in SrTiO3-δ; Co-L2,3 edge shifts indicate oxygen vacancies in ZnxCo1-xO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Muller et al. detected the oxygen vacancies in SrTiO3-δ from EELS O-K edge fine structure... Ling et al. determined the oxygen vacancies in ZnxCo1-xO from the EELS Co-L2,3 edge spectra

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR intensities increase significantly after introducing oxygen vacancies; strong signal at g=1.99 for reduced NiFe-OOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: both Zhu et al. and Sun et al. found the EPR intensities were increased a lot after introducing oxygen vacancies... strongly increased EPR signals at g = 1.99

nodes.characterization_summary: TGA-MS shows two weight loss stages in Sr2Fe1.3Ni0.2Mo0.5O6-δ under Ar; second loss from 290-700°C with O2 signal confirms lattice oxygen loss and oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Sr2Fe1.3Ni0.2Mo0.5O6-δ shows two weight loss stages from 50 to 700°C under Ar atmosphere... the other weight loss is assigned to the loss of lattice oxygen

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms oxygen vacancies in Co3O4 after Ar plasma treatment through changes in chemical environments.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ma et al. used XPS to determine oxygen vacancies in Co3O4 after treating the sample with Ar plasma
